name: Doublecommander
tagline: A free cross platform open source file manager with two panels side by side. It is inspired by Total Commander and features some new ideas.
description: Double Commander is a free cross platform open source file manager with two panels side by side. It is inspired by Total Commander and features some new ideas.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/doublecommander:version-8143f818@sha256:efd6e23446d4eca9a29e3ff81b1209e18a13465fa50073d4de4fb51e233a98ac
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
